senses: Yin (the negative principle of Yin and Yang)
阴:yin1.note: Dropped the trailing "genitalia" sense. Accurate CC-CEDICT content (a clinical/euphemistic anatomical usage), but bare and unqualified among weather/feng-shui senses on a beginner HSK-2 "overcast weather" card, it risks confusing or embarrassing a learner for no pedagogical benefit — check 3 (glosses not misleading out of context). All other senses (including "feminine"/"implicit"/"hidden", which are ordinary Yin-Yang-adjacent associations, not vulgar) are kept unchanged and in CC-CEDICT's original order.

鸟:niao3.note: Dropped two trailing senses: "(dialect) to pay attention to" (obscure, no value to a learner) and "(intensifier) damned; goddamn" (a coarse expletive usage derived from 鸟's vulgar homophone/near-homophone 屌 — inappropriate on a beginner "bird" card, check 3). "Bird" and the radical-name trivia are kept; nothing added.

春:chun1.note: Trimmed to the one sense an HSK-3 learner needs. CC-CEDICT's fuller entry ("spring (season)/gay/joyful/youthful/love/lust/life") reflects a real classical-literary register (春心, 怀春-type usage), but "gay" specifically will read to a modern English-speaking learner as "homosexual" — a meaning it does not have here — actively teaching a wrong association rather than merely omitting a nuance (check 3: glosses not misleading out of context). Removing the whole poetic-register cluster rather than picking through it individually, parallel to LR-002's precedent for 日:ri4.

奶奶:nai3nai5.note: Dropped the trailing "(coll.) boobies; breasts" sense — genuine CC-CEDICT content, but crude slang with no relevance to an HSK-3 "grandma" card and inappropriate for this context (check 3). Classifier (位) and the other two senses are unaffected.

绿:lv4.note: Dropped the trailing "(slang) (derived from 绿帽子) to cheat on (one's spouse or boyfriend or girlfriend)" sense — genuine modern slang, but an infidelity euphemism has no place on a beginner color-word card and is confusing out of context (check 3). "Green" alone is the correct, complete HSK-3 item; the reading (lǜ) already correctly excludes CC-CEDICT's separate bound-form "used in names" entry (lù), which was never a candidate here.

机场:ji1chang3.note: Dropped the trailing "(slang) service provider for Shadowsocks or similar software for circumventing Internet censorship" sense — genuine CC-CEDICT internet-slang content, but bizarre and actively confusing on a beginner "airport" card with no relevant context (check 3). "Airport; airfield" alone is correct and complete; classifiers (家/处) are unaffected.

踢:ti1.note: Dropped the trailing "(slang) butch (in a lesbian relationship)" sense — genuine CC-CEDICT slang content, but has no place on a beginner HSK-2 "to kick" card and is confusing/inappropriate out of context (check 3). The two core senses are unchanged.
